index.loading-error: The system checks could not be loaded.
index.checks-subtitle: The last result of each check.

SYSTEM.name: System
SYSTEM.description: Checks the backbone of the shop, for example the database connection. If a system check fails, the checks after it are not run.

FEATURE.name: Feature
FEATURE.description: Checks that a specific feature works, for example payments.

EXTERNAL.name: External
EXTERNAL.description: Checks that external services respond, for example the SMTP server.

AUXILIARY.name: Auxiliary
AUXILIARY.description: Checks supporting services, for example that background tasks run.

check-row.not-run: This check has not run yet.

LocalesReadiness.impact: Texts in these languages may be missing or show up wrong. Fix the locale codes in the language settings.

AdministrationReadiness.impact: Users may not be able to log in or work in the Administration. Rebuild the Administration and clear the cache.

SalesChannelsReadiness.impact: Customers may not reach your storefront. Clearing the cache or compiling the theme often helps.

ProductDetailReadiness.impact: Customers may not see your product pages. Clearing the cache or updating the indexes often helps.

ProductListingReadiness.impact: Customers may not see your category pages. Clearing the cache or updating the indexes often helps.

AppUrlVerification.impact: Apps can only be installed and receive data when this shop is reachable at APP_URL. Check the APP_URL environment variable and that the shop is reachable from the internet.

app-url.WARNING: APP_URL {appUrl} could not be verified. This is usually temporary.
app-url.ERROR: APP_URL {appUrl} does not point to this shop or is blocked, so apps cannot be installed.

administration.no-scripts: The Administration page loaded without its scripts.
administration.not-loading: The Administration page did not load.

locales.summary: {count} locale code is not valid. | {count} locale codes are not valid.

shop-id.app-url-missing: APP_URL is not configured or invalid, so apps cannot be connected.

changed.app_url: APP_URL changed from {stored} to {current}. This usually means the shop was copied, for example to staging, or moved to a new address.
changed.installation_path: The installation path changed from {stored} to {current}. This usually means the shop was copied or moved to a different server or folder.
changed.other: Your sales channel domains changed since your apps were connected.

shop-id.apps-on-hold: These apps receive no data until you confirm the change: {apps}
shop-id.no-apps-on-hold: No connected app is affected yet. Confirm whether this shop was moved or is a copy of another shop before you connect apps.
